name: push-object
title: Push an object
signature: push(object: object_ref, direction_xy: unit_vec2, distance_m: positive_number)
description: Slide an object along its support in a direction with closed fingers: from behind when there is room, or by pressing on its top and dragging when it stands against a wall or closed edge.
use_when: An object must slide along its support without grasping it.

not_to_be_confused_with.pull: pull drags toward the base to make an object reachable.
not_to_be_confused_with.expose: expose pushes until a graspable overhang exists.
not_to_be_confused_with.separate: separate pushes away from the nearest neighbour.
not_to_be_confused_with.center: center pushes away from the support edges.
not_to_be_confused_with.roll: roll makes a cylinder rotate instead of slide.
not_to_be_confused_with.tip: tip pushes high so the object falls over.

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: object_moved
postconditions.meaning: Object displaced along the direction by at least half the requested distance.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: object_moved
checks.meaning: Object displaced along the direction by at least half the requested distance.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_paths.note: The dispatcher chooses push or drag for thin items.

next.when: the object was pushed into a graspable spot

alternative.when: the object should come toward the robot
only one object has to move

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
